summary.headline: Planetary Days of Genesis
summary.text: Astrological interpretation of the six days of Genesis, assigning each day to a planet: Sun, Moon, Mars, Mercury, Jupiter, and Venus. The discussion links lunar phases and tides, Mars with vegetation and destruction, Mercury with astronomical observation, Jupiter with generation and animals, and Venus with human creation.
